title: Sweet Fantasy Candy Land Environment
description: A colorful and cheerful candy land-themed 3D environment, complete with a gingerbread-style house, lollipop trees, and giant ice cream scoops. This environment asset is ideal for casual adventure games, platformers, or child-friendly interactive fantasy worlds.

title: Sci-Fi Teleportation & Scan Lab Environment
description: A futuristic interior laboratory environment featuring a circular red light-emitting device and floating cube particle effects. This environment asset is ideal for sci-fi-themed games, secret base rooms, advanced research facilities, or teleportation sequences.

title: Indonesian School Classroom Interior
description: 3D model of a typical Indonesian school classroom interior. The model features fully textured student wooden desks and chairs, a teacher's desk with tablecloth, a large whiteboard, wall bulletin board, ceiling lights, air conditioner unit, tiled floor, side windows, and room doors.
